editionLabel: Perro Loko Games English section of multilingual rules
firstPlayerRule: The player who proves more knowledgeable about the Olympus of the gods goes first. The rules also allow the players to decide the starter by any other means.
clarifications: The two players alternate turns, beginning with the chosen starter.
Ornament tiles and location tokens belong to the advanced mode and are set aside for the basic game.
